name: Roxy
source: A Fire Elemental and the ruler of her demesne… or what little remains of it after an apocalyptic event covered it in scorching desert. Roxy is a fun-loving creature with a rudimentary understanding of human culture and history. She also burns hot enough to turn sand into glass…
